steps.en: Install Kombu into your Python service
steps.zh: 把 Kombu 装进你的 Python 服务

steps.en: Declare exchanges and queues as Python objects, then open one Connection by URL
steps.zh: 用对象声明 exchange/queue，按 URL 开连接

steps.en: The same transport interface serves amqp://, redis:// or sqs:// behind the URL
steps.zh: 同一传输接口管尽 amqp、redis、SQS 数种后端

steps.en: Publish through a Producer, declaring the queue with the message
steps.zh: 经 Producer 发布消息，随消息声明队列

steps.en: Serializes the payload and routes it to the bound queue
steps.zh: 序列化载荷并路由到绑定的队列

steps.en: Consume with a callback list plus an event loop
steps.zh: 用回调列表加事件循环来消费

steps.en: Delivers each message to your callback; your message.ack() confirms it
steps.zh: 把每条消息派发给你的回调，由 message.ack() 确认

value.en: One producer/consumer API across AMQP, Redis, SQS and more — moving brokers is a URL change, not a rewrite
value.zh: 一套生产/消费 API 横跨 AMQP、Redis、SQS 等——换 broker 只是换 URL，不是重写

sources: README.rst main @ 2026-09 (Quick overview / Installation): pip install kombu; from kombu import Connection, Exchange, Queue; Exchange('media', 'direct', durable=True); Queue('video', exchange=media_exchange, routing_key='video'); with Connection('amqp://guest:guest@localhost//') as conn:; producer = conn.Producer(serializer='json'); conn.Consumer(video_queue, callbacks=[process_media]); conn.drain_events(); message.ack()
